name: Julian Vane
appearance: A polished, indolent young gentleman with the Vane good looks worn more carelessly — fashionable dress, a languid, amused air.
definition: A younger relation of Captain Vane's line who never went to sea — charming, idle, and content to spend a fortune he did not earn. He drifts through drawing rooms trading on the family name and his own easy looks.
voice: Languid and teasing, all surface charm and lazy irony; he flirts as reflex and commits to nothing.
